source: IMG_5781.MOV: boot-sequence preset sent from twin3d.html over Web Serial (5 s: dcm:speed 127 + dcm:ramp 100 5000, 11 s: dcm:off); balance TANITA KJ-212 tared to 0.0 g
sync: full-speed brush comb locked 8.8-9.4 s video (100 % held boot 10-11 s)

comparison.lag_fit: best: thrust x0.80 + 0.5 s dead time (rms 0.16 g) but then peak 1.44 vs 1.8; scale 1.0 + 0.3 s + 0.4 s lag rms 0.21 g

conclusion: Full-speed thrust is not over-predicted (1.69 gf at the measured 3058 rpm vs 1.8 g peak). During the 5 s ramp the kitchen-balance display lags ~0.5 s and reads 0.2-0.4 g below the twin; the twin also runs 3 % fast at 100 % (warm-up drift), which adds ~6 % thrust on the page. A steady 5-6 s hold per duty is needed to test thrust.
